reason: I already have my Toplux and I just reorder it when it runs out, so I have no reason to switch. Foil sachets every day also feel like a lot of packaging waste to me.
objection: Sachets feel like more packaging waste, and I'm already happy with what I take. I forget my vitamins half the time anyway, so a new box on the counter wouldn't change that.
would_change_my_mind: A free trial or a much lower first price, plus a refill option that isn't a single-use foil sachet.
